scope: Exploratory development on four authored synthetic fixture families. Iterated prompts and retries are included. This is not a held-out benchmark, participant study, recorded screen-reader test, or accessibility certification.
provenanceNotes: Wizard and async were generated with prompt v5 and originally verified with passage-browser-v2; their exact accepted sources separately passed baseline and combined passage-browser-v3 audits without new inference.
Date was accepted under prompt v7 and combobox under prompt v8, both directly verified with passage-browser-v3. Historical failures and original receipts remain unchanged.

Receipt fields are copied as recorded. Missing historical responseFormat fields are not synthesized. The v5/v6 development profile used high reasoning with JSON-object framing; v7/v8 omit response_format and request a schema-shaped final response through the prompt, followed by strict local parsing. This profile change is an experiment, not proof of the cause of earlier malformed output.

Reasoning effort was requested as high; no actual reasoning-token counts were supplied in these application receipts. Protocol reasoning_content was excluded. Malformed message.content can itself contain explanatory prose; only digest/size metadata is public here.
Two initial provider-output failures predate final-content capture, so their raw final output cannot be reconstructed. All failed calls remain charged in the usage ledger.

Usage totals cover application-ledger requests only. Separate catalog and compatibility smoke requests made outside this application are excluded. Costs are estimates at uncached Fireworks input/output rates, not billing statements.

Check identifiers, expectations, statuses and evidence digests are retained; free-form observations, raw model outputs, source text, private capture fields, attendee values and local artifact URLs are excluded.

pricing.basis: Conservative uncached estimate, including all failed attempts; no cached-token discount assumed.
